render_minecraft_world: run the render CLI to render a Minecraft world to a PNG image using Chunky
gen_scene_json: generate a Chunky scene JSON string from argparse args and a scene name
render_with_camera: render a Minecraft world from a custom camera position and look angle to an output PNG
render_with_chunk_range: render a Minecraft world by specifying chunk min and max bounds for the render area
render_with_custom_size: render a Minecraft world to a custom width and height image size using the render CLI
